claims: The 98th Academy Awards took place on March 15, 2026.
A tie occurred in the Best Live Action Short Film category at the 98th Academy Awards.
The Singers (Sam A. Davis and Jack Piatt) won the Best Live Action Short Film category at the 98th Academy Awards.
Two People Exchanging Saliva (Natalie Musteata and Alexandre Singh) won the Best Live Action Short Film category at the 98th Academy Awards.
The tie is the seventh tie in Oscar history
